description: Catch-all nil for ANY Purnell-family surname spelling, whatever the other parameters. Same problem and same shape as record-search-flynn-any-variant-no-results — read that fixture's note for the full rationale. ut_search_records_020 stocks one decoy result under '~Purnell'; when the skill went on to try 'Purnall' (which the Search strategy dimension rewards it for doing) the call matched nothing and came back a fixture_not_found ERROR, and Tool Arguments was scored 2 even though the judge's own rationale said the override permitted 3. This absorbs any remaining Purn* query and returns the honest nil instead: only the decoy exists in this scenario, so a nil on every other spelling is the truthful answer. Keep it LAST in the test's mcp_fixtures list — matching is first-match-wins in list order, so an earlier catch-all would shadow the decoy fixture and break the test outright. Anchored to the name stem on purpose: a genuinely wrong search (different surname, malformed call) still misses and is still caught as a real defect.
